#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    return energy;
}

// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        // Check for NaN or Inf values
        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
        const double maxPos = 1e6;
        const double maxVel = 1e6;
        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
            printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
            printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int numBodies = 1024;
    int numSteps = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
    printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
    printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Initialize bodies
    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);
    randomizeBodies(bodies);
    
    // Run simulation
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(bodies);
        integrateBodies(bodies);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing
        std::vector<double> bodyData;
        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);
        for (const auto& body : bodies) {
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);
        }
        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }
    
    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        
        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {
            // Report final energy for reference
            double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);
            printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

codex
The original is a single-process all-pairs CPU loop. The scalable decomposition I’m using assigns each MPI rank a contiguous subset of target bodies, keeps the current global position snapshot on that rank’s GPU, computes and integrates its local bodies in a shared-memory-tiled CUDA kernel, then exchanges only updated positions with `MPI_Allgatherv`. OpenMP will cover the unavoidable host-side state packing, checking, and reductions without duplicating the GPU’s \(O(N^2)\) work.

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

+        constexpr int VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE = 4;
+        int localValidationMask = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(| : localValidationMask)
+        for (int i = 0; i < localBodies; ++i) {
+            const Vec3 position = hostGlobalPositions[localOffset + i];
+            const Vec3 velocity = hostLocalVelocities[i];
+            if (!std::isfinite(position.x) || !std::isfinite(position.y) ||
+                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
+                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
+                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+        }
+
+        int globalValidationMask = 0;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }
+
+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (globalValidationMask & NONFINITE_VALUE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
+            }
+            exitCode = EXIT_FAILURE;
         }
     }
-    
-    return 0;
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceLocalVelocities));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNextLocalPositions));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGlobalPositions));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
+    return exitCode;
 }

+    int length = 0;

+    std::abort();

[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
                 cudaGetErrorString(error));
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
    std::abort();
}

[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
    int length = 0;
    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
                 message);
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    std::abort();
}

#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                        \
    do {                                                                                        \
        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                             \
        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                                   \
            abortCuda(cuda_check_error, #call, rank);                                            \
        }                                                                                       \
    } while (false)

        if (mpi_check_error != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                                    \
            abortMpi(mpi_check_error, #call, rank);                                              \
        }                                                                                       \
    } while (false)

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;

+}

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);

+        return false;

+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                        \

+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                             \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                                   \
+            abortCuda(cuda_check_error, #call, rank);                                            \
+        }                                                                                       \

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);

+[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(error));

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(error));

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);

+                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
+                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
+                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+        }
+
+        int globalValidationMask = 0;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }
+
+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;

+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");

+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+        }
+
+        int globalValidationMask = 0;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }
+
+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (globalValidationMask & NONFINITE_VALUE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
+            }
+            exitCode = EXIT_FAILURE;
         }
     }

-    return 0;

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNextLocalPositions));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGlobalPositions));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));

+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));

+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }

+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));

+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));

+            }

+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {

+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");

+                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
+                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
+                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||

+        }

+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {

+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(

+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));

+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));

+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }

+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {

+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);

+                }
+            }

+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }

-            return 1;

+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");

+                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
+                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
+                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+        }
+
+        int globalValidationMask = 0;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }
+
+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {

+                    std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
+            }

+                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
+                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
+                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
+                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+        }

+        int globalValidationMask = 0;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }

+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {

+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");

+        }

+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            if (localBodies > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((localBodies + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));

+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, localOffset);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,

+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));

+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }

+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {

-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {

+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
+            }

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    std::abort();
+}

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
+                 message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+            const double dz = globalPositions[j].z - position.z;
+            energy -= 1.0 / sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+bool cudaAwareMpiAvailable() {

+        return std::strcmp(overrideValue, "1") == 0 ||
+               std::strcmp(overrideValue, "true") == 0 ||
+               std::strcmp(overrideValue, "TRUE") == 0;
+    }
+#if defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)

+                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
+                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
+            }
+            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||

+            }

+                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
+        }
+
+        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
+                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
+                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+            double localEnergy = 0.0;
+            const int potentialRows =
+                rank < numBodies ? 1 + (numBodies - 1 - rank) / worldSize : 0;
+            const int energyItems = std::max(localBodies, potentialRows);
+            if (energyItems > 0) {
+                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
+                    1, std::min((energyItems + ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
+                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
+                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
+                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
+                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
+                    localBodies, rank, worldSize);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
+                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
+                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
+                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
+                }
+            }
+
+            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
+                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
+                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
+            }
         } else {
-            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
-            return 1;
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                if (globalValidationMask & NONFINITE_VALUE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
+                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
+                }
+                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
+            }
+            exitCode = EXIT_FAILURE;
         }
     }
-    
-    return 0;
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceLocalVelocities));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNextLocalPositions));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGlobalPositions));
+    if (hostGlobalPositions != nullptr) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
+    return exitCode;
 }

    45	[[noreturn]] void abortCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const int rank) {
    46	    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA call %s failed: %s\n", rank, expression,
    47	                 cudaGetErrorString(error));

    49	    std::abort();
    50	}

    53	    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
    54	    int length = 0;
    55	    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    56	    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: MPI call %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, expression, length,
    57	                 message);
    58	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    59	    std::abort();
    60	}

    78	void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    79	    // Keep the original rand_r call order so rank zero creates exactly the same initial state.
    80	    for (auto& body : bodies) {
    81	        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    82	        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    83	        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    84	        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    85	        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    86	        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    87	    }
    88	}

    90	template <int BLOCK_SIZE>
    91	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE)
    92	void advanceBodies(const Vec3* __restrict__ globalPositions, Vec3* __restrict__ nextLocalPositions,
    93	                   Vec3* __restrict__ localVelocities, const int numBodies,
    94	                   const int localBodies, const int localOffset) {
    95	    if (localBodies == 0) {
    96	        return;
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];
   100	    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];
   101	    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];
   102	
   103	    const int localIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_SIZE +
   104	                           static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
   105	    const bool active = localIndex < localBodies;
   106	
   107	    double px = 0.0;
   108	    double py = 0.0;
   109	    double pz = 0.0;
   110	    if (active) {
   111	        const Vec3 position = globalPositions[localOffset + localIndex];
   112	        px = position.x;
   113	        py = position.y;
   114	        pz = position.z;
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    double forceX = 0.0;
   118	    double forceY = 0.0;
   119	    double forceZ = 0.0;
   120	
   121	    for (int tileBase = 0; tileBase < numBodies; tileBase += BLOCK_SIZE) {
   122	        const int sourceIndex = tileBase + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
   123	        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
   124	            const Vec3 source = globalPositions[sourceIndex];
   125	            tileX[threadIdx.x] = source.x;
   126	            tileY[threadIdx.x] = source.y;
   127	            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = source.z;
   128	        }
   129	        __syncthreads();
   130	
   131	        if (active) {
   132	            const int tileSize = min(BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileBase);
   133	#pragma unroll 8
   134	            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
   135	                const double dx = tileX[j] - px;
   136	                const double dy = tileY[j] - py;
   137	                const double dz = tileZ[j] - pz;
   138	                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
   139	                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
   140	                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
   141	                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
   142	                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
   143	                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
   144	                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   145	            }
   146	        }
   147	        __syncthreads();
   148	    }
   149	
   150	    if (active) {
   151	        Vec3 velocity = localVelocities[localIndex];
   152	        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
   153	        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
   154	        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
   155	        localVelocities[localIndex] = velocity;
   156	        nextLocalPositions[localIndex] =
   157	            Vec3(px + velocity.x * DT, py + velocity.y * DT, pz + velocity.z * DT);
   158	    }
   159	}
   160	
   161	__global__ __launch_bounds__(ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE)
   162	void computeEnergyPartials(const Vec3* __restrict__ globalPositions,
   163	                           const Vec3* __restrict__ localVelocities,
   164	                           double* __restrict__ blockEnergy, const int numBodies,
   165	                           const int localBodies, const int rank, const int worldSize) {
   166	    __shared__ double scratch[ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE];
   167	
   168	    double energy = 0.0;
   169	    const int gridStride = static_cast<int>(gridDim.x) * ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE;
   170	    for (int localIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE +
   171	                          static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
   172	         localIndex < localBodies; localIndex += gridStride) {
   173	        const Vec3 velocity = localVelocities[localIndex];
   174	        energy += 0.5 * (velocity.x * velocity.x + velocity.y * velocity.y +
   175	                         velocity.z * velocity.z);
   176	    }
   177	
   178	    // Cyclic ownership of potential-energy rows balances the triangular pair space across ranks.
   179	    const int potentialRows =
   180	        rank < numBodies ? 1 + (numBodies - 1 - rank) / worldSize : 0;
   181	    for (int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE +
   182	                   static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
   183	         row < potentialRows; row += gridStride) {
   184	        const int globalIndex = rank + row * worldSize;
   185	        const Vec3 position = globalPositions[globalIndex];
   186	        for (int j = globalIndex + 1; j < numBodies; ++j) {
   187	            const double dx = globalPositions[j].x - position.x;
   188	            const double dy = globalPositions[j].y - position.y;
   189	            const double dz = globalPositions[j].z - position.z;
   190	            energy -= 1.0 / sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
   191	        }
   192	    }
   193	
   194	    scratch[threadIdx.x] = energy;
   195	    __syncthreads();
   196	
   197	    for (int stride = ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
   198	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
   199	            scratch[threadIdx.x] += scratch[threadIdx.x + stride];
   200	        }
   201	        __syncthreads();
   202	    }
   203	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   204	        blockEnergy[blockIdx.x] = scratch[0];
   205	    }
   206	}

   285	            }
   286	            validArguments = false;
   287	        }
   288	    }
   289	
   290	    // Counts are passed as MPI_DOUBLE, so keep all collective counts representable by int.
   291	    if (numBodies <= 0 || numBodies > INT_MAX / 6 || numSteps < 0) {
   292	        validArguments = false;
   293	    }
   294	    if (showHelp || !validArguments) {
   295	        if (rank == 0) {
   296	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   297	        }
   298	        MPI_Finalize();
   299	        return showHelp && validArguments ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   300	    }
   301	
   302	    omp_set_dynamic(0);
   303	
   304	    MPI_Comm localCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   305	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL,
   306	                                  &localCommunicator));
   307	    int localRank = 0;
   308	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(localCommunicator, &localRank));
   309	
   310	    int deviceCount = 0;
   311	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   312	    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
   313	        if (localRank == 0) {
   314	            std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA device is visible to the node-local MPI ranks\n");
   315	        }
   316	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   317	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   318	    }
   319	    // This handles both common launch modes: all node GPUs visible to every rank, or one
   320	    // distinct CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES entry presented as device zero to each rank.
   321	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   322	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   323	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   324	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   325	
   326	    int cudaAware = cudaAwareMpiAvailable() ? 1 : 0;
   327	    int cudaAwareEverywhere = 0;
   328	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&cudaAware, &cudaAwareEverywhere, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN,
   329	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   330	    cudaAware = cudaAwareEverywhere;
   331	
   332	    std::vector<int> bodyCounts(worldSize);
   333	    std::vector<int> bodyOffsets(worldSize);
   334	    std::vector<int> counts3(worldSize);
   335	    std::vector<int> offsets3(worldSize);
   336	    std::vector<int> counts6(worldSize);
   337	    std::vector<int> offsets6(worldSize);
   338	    for (int process = 0; process < worldSize; ++process) {
   339	        const int begin = static_cast<int>((static_cast<long long>(numBodies) * process) /
   340	                                           worldSize);
   341	        const int end = static_cast<int>((static_cast<long long>(numBodies) * (process + 1)) /
   342	                                         worldSize);
   343	        bodyOffsets[process] = begin;
   344	        bodyCounts[process] = end - begin;
   345	        counts3[process] = 3 * bodyCounts[process];
   346	        offsets3[process] = 3 * bodyOffsets[process];
   347	        counts6[process] = 6 * bodyCounts[process];
   348	        offsets6[process] = 6 * bodyOffsets[process];
   349	    }
   350	    const int localOffset = bodyOffsets[rank];
   351	    const int localBodies = bodyCounts[rank];
   352	    const bool needFinalState = printResults || validate;
   353	
   354	    Vec3* hostGlobalPositions = nullptr;
   355	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hostGlobalPositions,
   356	                              static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3)));
   357	
   358	    std::vector<Body> initialBodies;
   359	    if (rank == 0) {
   360	        initialBodies.resize(numBodies);
   361	        randomizeBodies(initialBodies);
   362	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   363	        for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {
   364	            hostGlobalPositions[i] = initialBodies[i].pos;
   365	        }
   366	    }
   367	
   368	    std::vector<Body> localInitialBodies(localBodies);
   369	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Scatterv(rank == 0 ? static_cast<const void*>(initialBodies.data()) : nullptr,
   370	                           counts6.data(), offsets6.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,
   371	                           static_cast<void*>(localInitialBodies.data()), 6 * localBodies,
   372	                           MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   373	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hostGlobalPositions, 3 * numBodies, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   374	
   375	    std::vector<Vec3> hostLocalVelocities(std::max(localBodies, 1));
   376	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   377	    for (int i = 0; i < localBodies; ++i) {
   378	        hostLocalVelocities[i] = localInitialBodies[i].vel;
   379	    }
   380	    initialBodies.clear();
   381	    initialBodies.shrink_to_fit();
   382	    localInitialBodies.clear();
   383	    localInitialBodies.shrink_to_fit();
   384	
   385	    Vec3* deviceGlobalPositions = nullptr;
   386	    Vec3* deviceNextLocalPositions = nullptr;
   387	    Vec3* deviceLocalVelocities = nullptr;
   388	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGlobalPositions,
   389	                          static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3)));
   390	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceNextLocalPositions,
   391	                          static_cast<size_t>(std::max(localBodies, 1)) * sizeof(Vec3)));
   392	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceLocalVelocities,
   393	                          static_cast<size_t>(std::max(localBodies, 1)) * sizeof(Vec3)));
   394	
   395	    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   396	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   397	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
   398	                               static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   399	                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   400	    if (localBodies > 0) {
   401	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceLocalVelocities, hostLocalVelocities.data(),
   402	                                   static_cast<size_t>(localBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   403	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    // Small target partitions need more blocks to occupy the whole GPU; larger partitions use
   407	    // wider tiles to reduce synchronization and source-load overhead.
   408	    const bool useSmallForceBlocks =
   409	        static_cast<long long>(localBodies) <
   410	        8LL * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount * LARGE_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
   411	    const int forceBlockSize =
   412	        useSmallForceBlocks ? SMALL_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE : LARGE_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
   413	    const int gridSize = (localBodies + forceBlockSize - 1) / forceBlockSize;
   414	    const auto launchAdvance = [&](const int bodies, const int blocks) {
   415	        if (useSmallForceBlocks) {
   416	            advanceBodies<SMALL_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, SMALL_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
   417	                deviceGlobalPositions, deviceNextLocalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, numBodies,
   418	                bodies, localOffset);
   419	        } else {
   420	            advanceBodies<LARGE_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, LARGE_FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
   421	                deviceGlobalPositions, deviceNextLocalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, numBodies,
   422	                bodies, localOffset);
   423	        }
   424	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   425	    };
   426	
   427	    // Force CUDA module loading/JIT before the measured region without changing any body.
   428	    launchAdvance(0, 1);
   429	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   430	    if (cudaAware && !needFinalState) {
   431	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));
   432	        hostGlobalPositions = nullptr;
   433	    }
   434	
   435	    if (rank == 0) {
   436	        std::printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
   437	        std::printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
   438	        std::printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
   439	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   440	        std::printf("Parallel configuration: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, "
   441	                    "one CUDA GPU/rank\n",
   442	                    worldSize, omp_get_max_threads());
   443	        std::printf("Position exchange: %s\n",
   444	                    cudaAware ? "CUDA-aware MPI (device direct)" : "MPI with pinned-host staging");
   445	    }
   446	
   447	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   448	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   449	
   450	    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
   451	        if (localBodies > 0) {
   452	            launchAdvance(localBodies, gridSize);
   453	        }
   454	
   455	        if (step + 1 < numSteps) {
   456	            if (cudaAware) {
   457	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   458	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(deviceNextLocalPositions, 3 * localBodies, MPI_DOUBLE,
   459	                                         deviceGlobalPositions, counts3.data(), offsets3.data(),
   460	                                         MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   461	            } else {
   462	                if (localBodies > 0) {
   463	                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostGlobalPositions + localOffset,
   464	                                               deviceNextLocalPositions,
   465	                                               static_cast<size_t>(localBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   466	                                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   467	                }
   468	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   469	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL,
   470	                                         hostGlobalPositions, counts3.data(), offsets3.data(),
   471	                                         MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   472	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
   473	                                           static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   474	                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   475	            }
   476	        }
   477	    }
   478	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   479	
   480	    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   481	    double maximumElapsed = 0.0;
   482	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maximumElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   483	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   484	    if (rank == 0) {
   485	        const auto elapsedMilliseconds = static_cast<long long>(maximumElapsed * 1000.0);
   486	        std::printf("Simulation time: %lld ms\n", elapsedMilliseconds);
   487	    }
   488	
   489	    if (needFinalState) {
   490	        if (numSteps > 0) {
   491	            if (localBodies > 0) {
   492	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostGlobalPositions + localOffset,
   493	                                           deviceNextLocalPositions,
   494	                                           static_cast<size_t>(localBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   495	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   496	            }
   497	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   498	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL,
   499	                                     hostGlobalPositions, counts3.data(), offsets3.data(),
   500	                                     MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   501	        }
   502	        if (localBodies > 0) {
   503	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostLocalVelocities.data(), deviceLocalVelocities,
   504	                                       static_cast<size_t>(localBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   505	                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   506	        }
   507	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   508	    }
   509	
   510	    if (printResults) {
   511	        std::vector<Vec3> globalVelocities;
   512	        if (rank == 0) {
   513	            globalVelocities.resize(numBodies);
   514	        }
   515	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(hostLocalVelocities.data(), 3 * localBodies, MPI_DOUBLE,
   516	                              rank == 0 ? static_cast<void*>(globalVelocities.data()) : nullptr,
   517	                              counts3.data(), offsets3.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   518	
   519	        if (rank == 0) {
   520	            std::vector<double> bodyData(static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * 6);
   521	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   522	            for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {
   523	                const size_t output = static_cast<size_t>(i) * 6;
   524	                bodyData[output] = hostGlobalPositions[i].x;
   525	                bodyData[output + 1] = hostGlobalPositions[i].y;
   526	                bodyData[output + 2] = hostGlobalPositions[i].z;
   527	                bodyData[output + 3] = globalVelocities[i].x;
   528	                bodyData[output + 4] = globalVelocities[i].y;
   529	                bodyData[output + 5] = globalVelocities[i].z;
   530	            }
   531	            print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
   532	        }
   533	    }
   534	
   535	    int exitCode = EXIT_SUCCESS;
   536	    if (validate) {
   537	        constexpr int NONFINITE_VALUE = 1;
   538	        constexpr int POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE = 2;
   539	        constexpr int VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE = 4;
   540	        int localValidationMask = 0;
   541	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(| : localValidationMask)
   542	        for (int i = 0; i < localBodies; ++i) {
   543	            const Vec3 position = hostGlobalPositions[localOffset + i];
   544	            const Vec3 velocity = hostLocalVelocities[i];
   545	            if (!std::isfinite(position.x) || !std::isfinite(position.y) ||
   546	                !std::isfinite(position.z) || !std::isfinite(velocity.x) ||
   547	                !std::isfinite(velocity.y) || !std::isfinite(velocity.z)) {
   548	                localValidationMask |= NONFINITE_VALUE;
   549	            }
   550	            if (std::abs(position.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(position.y) > 1e6 ||
   551	                std::abs(position.z) > 1e6) {
   552	                localValidationMask |= POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE;
   553	            }
   554	            if (std::abs(velocity.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(velocity.y) > 1e6 ||
   555	                std::abs(velocity.z) > 1e6) {
   556	                localValidationMask |= VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE;
   557	            }
   558	        }
   559	
   560	        int globalValidationMask = 0;
   561	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localValidationMask, &globalValidationMask, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_BOR,
   562	                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   563	        if (rank == 0) {
   564	            std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
   565	        }
   566	
   567	        if (globalValidationMask == 0) {
   568	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(deviceGlobalPositions, hostGlobalPositions,
   569	                                       static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * sizeof(Vec3),
   570	                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   571	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   572	
   573	            double localEnergy = 0.0;
   574	            const int potentialRows =
   575	                rank < numBodies ? 1 + (numBodies - 1 - rank) / worldSize : 0;
   576	            const int energyItems = std::max(localBodies, potentialRows);
   577	            if (energyItems > 0) {
   578	                const int energyBlocks = std::max(
   579	                    1, std::min((energyItems + ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE,
   580	                                4 * deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount));
   581	                double* deviceEnergy = nullptr;
   582	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceEnergy,
   583	                                      static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double)));
   584	                computeEnergyPartials<<<energyBlocks, ENERGY_BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(
   585	                    deviceGlobalPositions, deviceLocalVelocities, deviceEnergy, numBodies,
   586	                    localBodies, rank, worldSize);
   587	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   588	                std::vector<double> energyParts(energyBlocks);
   589	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(energyParts.data(), deviceEnergy,
   590	                                           static_cast<size_t>(energyBlocks) * sizeof(double),
   591	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   592	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   593	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceEnergy));
   594	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localEnergy)
   595	                for (int i = 0; i < energyBlocks; ++i) {
   596	                    localEnergy += energyParts[i];
   597	                }
   598	            }
   599	
   600	            double totalEnergy = 0.0;
   601	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
   602	                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   603	            if (rank == 0) {
   604	                std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", totalEnergy);
   605	                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   606	            }
   607	        } else {
   608	            if (rank == 0) {
   609	                if (globalValidationMask & NONFINITE_VALUE) {
   610	                    std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
   611	                }
   612	                if (globalValidationMask & POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
   613	                    std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   614	                }
   615	                if (globalValidationMask & VELOCITY_OUT_OF_RANGE) {
   616	                    std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   617	                }
   618	                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   619	            }
   620	            exitCode = EXIT_FAILURE;
   621	        }
   622	    }
   623	
   624	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
   625	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceLocalVelocities));
   626	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNextLocalPositions));
   627	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGlobalPositions));
   628	    if (hostGlobalPositions != nullptr) {
   629	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));
   630	    }
   631	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
   632	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   633	    return exitCode;
   634	}

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(const int error, const char* expression, const int rank) {

+    int length = 0;

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;

+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);

codex
One subtle numerical point is worth checking before handoff: GPU fused multiply-add can change a few least-significant bits even when all reported values and energies agree. I’m testing the compiler’s non-fused mode against the original hash now; I’ll keep the faster setting unless it materially improves equivalence.

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

+    if (hostGlobalPositions != nullptr) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostGlobalPositions));
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
+    return exitCode;
 }

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
     return true;

codex
Implemented the mandatory hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version without adding files or changing the `nbody` executable name.

Key changes:

- Shared-memory-tiled CUDA force/integration kernels with adaptive block sizing.
- MPI target-body decomposition and per-step `MPI_Allgatherv`.
- CUDA-aware MPI device transfers when supported; pinned-host staging otherwise.
- OpenMP-parallel initialization, result packing, validation, and energy reduction.
- One-GPU-per-rank node-local mapping.
- Required MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA build configuration with native GPU architecture targeting.

+bool parseInteger(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;

+        return false;
     }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
